en.headline: John Lee says Northern Metropolis university towns aim to attract world's finest scholars
en.dek: Speaking at the Global University Presidents and Leaders Summit, the Chief Executive invited institutions to set up research platforms and strengthen industry-academia links.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday that the three university towns planned in the Northern Metropolis are designed to attract the world's finest scholars and students while empowering industry.

Addressing the opening of the Global University Presidents and Leaders Summit at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, Lee noted that Hong Kong is home to five universities ranked among the world's top 100 and attracts students from more than 100 countries. He said the Northern Metropolis, a core part of the city's first five-year plan, will focus on the university towns at San Tin, Hung Shui Kiu and Ta Kwu Ling.

According to Lee, the campus areas across the three towns now total about 300 hectares, expanded from an earlier figure of more than 80 hectares, and the overall development including surrounding technology, industry and living areas will exceed 1,000 hectares. The government will invite institutions to establish basic research institutes and shared platforms such as high-performance computing centres, joint laboratories and interdisciplinary centres.

Lee said the towns would encourage university staff to conduct research at companies and industry professionals to contribute to teaching and research, aiming to strengthen links between industry, academia and research so they complement one another. More than 50 university leaders from over 20 countries and regions attended the two-day event.

zh.headline: 李家超：北都大學城旨在吸引全球頂尖學者及學生
zh.dek: 行政長官在全球大學校長及領袖高峰會致辭，邀請機構設立研究平台，加強產學研聯繫，三個大學城連同周邊發展面積逾1000公頃。
body: 行政長官李家超星期二表示，北部都會區的三個大學城旨在吸引全球最優秀的學者和學生，同時賦能產業界。
李家超在會展舉行的全球大學校長及領袖高峰會開幕禮致辭時指出，香港擁有五所世界百強大學，吸引來自逾100個國家和地區的學生。他稱北部都會區是首個五年規劃及香港未來發展的核心，重點是新田、洪水橋及打鼓嶺的三個大學城。
李家超表示，三個大學城的校園區面積現已擴至約300公頃，較早前預留的逾80公頃大幅增加；連同周邊科技區、產業區及生活社區，整體面積將超過1000公頃。政府將邀請機構設立基礎研究所及大型共享研究平台，包括高效能運算中心、聯合實驗室及跨學科研究中心。
他指出，大學城將鼓勵大學教職員到企業開展研究，亦歡迎業界人士參與教學及研究，目標是加強產學研聯繫，做到優勢互補。是次為期兩日的高峰會有逾50位來自20多個國家和地區的大學領袖出席。
